answers.question: Bane NOR's track table looks out of date (it lists one passenger platform, track 3 covering 3 and 2, while OSM has platforms 1;2, 3;4 and 5;6 after the Follobanen opening in Dec 2022): which tracks/platforms are signposted and in use?
answers.answer: Six platform tracks, 1-6, on three island platforms: 1/2, 3/4 and 5/6. The Norwegian track table (one island platform for tracks 3 and 2, 600 mm) is the pre-Follobanen table. Bane NOR's own English page for the same station has the current table: island platform between tracks 2 and 1 (350 m, 760 mm, 7 m wide), between tracks 3 and 4 (350 m, 760 mm, 7 m) and between tracks 6 and 5 (288 m, 760 mm, 5 m); island platforms at stub tracks 12/13 (340/100 mm) are for stabling, not passengers. Entur's stop register (what departure boards and journey planners show) has six rail quays with public codes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Bane NOR's S-sirkulære 124-2022 put tracks 4, 5 and 6 into use as platform tracks from 6 Aug 2022 (track 6 platform 288 m) and says the eastern line (Østre linje) reaches only tracks 5 and 6. Wikipedia: 'The new station includes six platforms' (meaning six platform tracks). The physical signs (track numbers 1-6) were not seen in a photo or plan, so 'signposted' rests on Entur's public codes.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts?
answers.answer: Bane NOR: stairs, ramp and lift to the platforms. OSM has three lifts, long ramps and short stairs from the underpass. The OSM extract has no platform geometry, so OSM does not say which lift serves which island platform. Three lifts for three island platforms fits, but no source confirms the pairing.

answers.question: Which lift/ramp/stair reaches which island platform (1/2, 3/4, 5/6): the OSM extract has no platforms; no owner plan read (banenor.no track plan image did not load).
answers.answer: Lifts serve platform 1/2, platform 3/4, platform 5/6 (The raw OSM extract has the three islands (r11180738 1;2, r11180737 3;4, r11180736 5;6), all at level 0. The underpass lifts (-1;0) map one to each island: n9941248966 serves 1/2, n9941248968 serves 3/4, and n9941248945 serves 5/6. n9941248952 (west) and n11650716936 (east) are 15.9 m and 14.8 m from the nearest island, so they are underpass-to-street lifts. Source is OSM only.)
